answer: Tie rewards to account age through slow vesting. Each new agent's earnings stay locked for many epochs, and any duplicate or colluding answer flagged by peer graders forfeits the whole locked pile. Trust builds like basalt layering on a mesa, one epoch at a time, so it can't be bought quickly. A sybil farm must keep every puppet writing distinct, coherent work for months while its capital sits frozen, and one slip wipes it out. The velvet of easy early payouts never arrives, so the attack costs far more than it returns.
